meta.title: OctopusVidGen: free AI film studio with 123 styles
meta.description: Plan a short film with Claude in your own language and get back an MP4 drawn, voiced and scored in code, in one of 123 styles. Free and open source.
alt.artDeco: A gold Art Deco title card
hero.lead: Pick a style, plan the film with Claude in your own language, and get back an MP4 that Claude wrote, drew in code, voiced and scored. No account, no sign-up.
hero.windowLabel: The studio's planning chat: Claude reads the Watercolor Brush style and asks who should narrate the film
hero.msgMe: A 45-second film for Instagram about our coffee, from the seed to the cup.
hero.msgBot: Then 9:16, vertical. Who should narrate: a warm synthetic voice, or your own recording? And in English or Burmese?

studio.p: A progress bar walks through the stages while Claude works. It may stop to ask you something: answer in the chat, or ask for changes once the MP4 is done.
studio.frameLabel: The studio: films in a project on the left; the open film's progress bar, stages and chat with Claude on the right
studio.q: Can the last shot end on the farm's name, in brush lettering?
studio.a: Yes, it's in the plan for scene 6. One question while I draw scene 2: should the rain on the coffee trees be light or heavy?
features.h: More than one film at a time.
features.hm: Series, your own files, pictures and your language.
features.c1p: A project is a folder of episodes. Characters and assets made for the first film come back in the next one.
features.n1b: Same cast: the grandfather and the cat
features.c2: Your photos and voice in the film
features.c2p: Drag or paste files into the chat: photos, your logo, a voice recording, video clips, a song.
features.c4p: The studio, the planning chat and the narration follow the language you pick, from Burmese to Portuguese.
start.h: Run the studio in four commands
start.p: OctopusVidGen uses your own Claude Code, so there is nothing to sign up for.
start.n1: Claude Code, signed in with a Claude subscription or an API key.
start.n2: Node.js and Rust to build the studio and run its server.
start.n3: Optional: Claude in Chrome, so picture styles can make images with Google Flow.
faq.p: What people ask before their first film.
faq.a1: OctopusVidGen is free. Films run on your own Claude Code, so they count against your Claude plan or your API key.
faq.q2: Does the studio need an account?
faq.a2: No. There is no sign-up. The studio runs on your computer and keeps your films there.
faq.q3: Can I use the films for client work?
faq.a3: The films you make are yours. Some styles' rules are non-commercial: the Lemo-Opuscar style guides are CC BY-NC 4.0, and the onetake styles are for non-commercial use. Check a style before client work.
faq.q5: How long does one film take to make?
faq.a5: Usually 10 to 20 minutes. Every frame is drawn and rendered on your computer.
close.h: The whole studio, free on GitHub
close.p: Open source. No account. Your films stay on your computer.
